descriptions.w3d_d25h_screen_show_800c7cd0: Loading screen visibility: stores the on flag, forwards it to the render instance, and when the screen is enabled and turned on loads the two indicator images if missing, positions them at -32 and 64, starts the timer, opens sound range 59..61 and fades them in over 30 steps of 8.5; otherwise closes sound range 0..58 and releases the images.
